definitions.precision_recall_f1: Micro counts at fixed confidence, class-aware matching at IoU >= 0.5 using Ultralytics validator.
definitions.map: Macro AP over classes with ground truth; confidence sweep >= 0.001, Ultralytics YOLO evaluator, not official pycocotools COCO AP.
definitions.zero_denominators: null when undefined; classes with zero GT excluded from mAP, retained in FP counts.
definitions.project_classes: Select supported ThirdEyes class names from all-class predictions; not complete Object Finder pipeline.
definitions.scope: Public COCO validation subset; model development may have used COCO validation. Not independent Kinect accuracy.
definitions.runtime_difference: Application searches one class, max_det=30; benchmark detects all classes, max_det=300. No depth, voice or camera.
